thought.text: The model download IS progressing (1.9GB downloaded into `.local/models`). The "0%" bar is just not refreshing in logs. Let me continue monitoring as the models download and services come up.

reasoning_content:
The model download is actually in progress (1.9G has been downloaded into the model volume — the faster-whisper model is being downloaded). The "0%" progress bar is misleading. Let's continue waiting. The model is large (the faster-whisper-large-v3 model is about 3GB). The pyannote model will also need to be downloaded.

Let's keep monitoring. The download is clearly progressing. Let's wait a bit longer.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  sleep 55
  sz=$(du -sh .local/models 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
  st=$(docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1 | grep asr)
  echo "iter $i: models=$sz  asr[$st]"
  last=$(docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -iE "Found|diarization|serving|started|error|failed|Uvicorn|running" | tail -1)
  [ -n "$last" ] && echo "   last-interesting: $last"
  if echo "$st" | grep -qE "Restarting|Exited"; then echo "STATE CHANGE"; break; fi
  if docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs asr-service 2>&1 | grep -qiE "Uvicorn running|serving|Started server"; then echo "ASR SERVE DETECTED"; break; fi
done
